arguments.sql:
WITH batting_profile AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS batting_rows,
           COUNT(DISTINCT player_id) AS batting_players,
           COUNT(CASE WHEN typeof(g) NOT IN ('integer', 'real', 'null') THEN 1 END) AS g_nonnumeric,
           COUNT(CASE WHEN typeof(r) NOT IN ('integer', 'real', 'null') THEN 1 END) AS r_nonnumeric,
           COUNT(CASE WHEN typeof(h) NOT IN ('integer', 'real', 'null') THEN 1 END) AS h_nonnumeric,
           COUNT(CASE WHEN typeof(hr) NOT IN ('integer', 'real', 'null') THEN 1 END) AS hr_nonnumeric,
           MAX(g) AS max_g,
           MAX(CASE WHEN typeof(r) IN ('integer', 'real') THEN r END) AS max_r,
           MAX(CASE WHEN typeof(h) IN ('integer', 'real') THEN h END) AS max_h,
           MAX(CASE WHEN typeof(hr) IN ('integer', 'real') THEN hr END) AS max_hr
    FROM main.batting
),
player_profile AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS player_rows, COUNT(DISTINCT player_id) AS player_keys
    FROM main.player
),
join_profile AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS matched_batting_rows
    FROM main.batting AS b
    JOIN main.player AS p ON p.player_id = b.player_id
)
SELECT *
FROM batting_profile
CROSS JOIN player_profile
CROSS JOIN join_profile

WITH maxima AS (
    SELECT MAX(g) AS games_played,
           MAX(CASE WHEN typeof(r) IN ('integer', 'real') THEN r END) AS runs,
           MAX(CASE WHEN typeof(h) IN ('integer', 'real') THEN h END) AS hits,
           MAX(CASE WHEN typeof(hr) IN ('integer', 'real') THEN hr END) AS home_runs
    FROM main.batting
),
leaders AS (
    SELECT 1 AS stat_order, 'Games played' AS statistic, b.player_id, b.g AS score_value
    FROM main.batting AS b
    JOIN maxima AS m ON b.g = m.games_played
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 2, 'Runs', b.player_id, b.r
    FROM main.batting AS b
    JOIN maxima AS m ON b.r = m.runs
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 3, 'Hits', b.player_id, b.h
    FROM main.batting AS b
    JOIN maxima AS m ON b.h = m.hits
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 4, 'Home runs', b.player_id, b.hr
    FROM main.batting AS b
    JOIN maxima AS m ON b.hr = m.home_runs
)
SELECT p.name_given, l.statistic, l.score_value
FROM leaders AS l
JOIN main.player AS p ON p.player_id = l.player_id
ORDER BY l.stat_order, p.name_given, l.player_id
LIMIT -1
